story_info.title: Penny Penguin's Bright White Smile
story_info.subtitle: A Story About Keeping Teeth Clean
story_info.moral: Brushing your teeth keeps them healthy and helps you feel good.

main_character.name: Penny Penguin
main_character.appearance: Penny is a small round penguin with glossy black-and-white feathers, a bright orange beak, and orange webbed feet. She has rosy cheeks and a cheerful, energetic stance.

cover.prompt: A Pixar-quality 3D illustration of Penny Penguin smiling brightly with shiny white teeth, holding a blue toothbrush. She is standing on the snowy shore with gentle waves behind her. Soft lighting, pastel colours, children's book style, vertical composition.
cover.visual_action: Penny Penguin smiling with clean teeth

slides.title: A Sunny Saturday Morning
slides.text: Penny Penguin woke up early. The sun peeked over Snowy Shores. "It's Saturday!" she chirped. "Time for fun!" She stretched her little wings. Penny felt so happy. She thought about playing outside. Running on the soft snow sounded nice. She wanted to slide and splash. "What a wonderful day!" Penny giggled. Her bright orange beak smiled. She felt bouncy and ready to go.
slides.speaker_notes: Penny Penguin wakes up excited for a fun Saturday, ready to play on Snowy Shores.

slides.title: Something Important to Remember
slides.text: Penny almost hopped out the door. Then, she stopped. "Wait a minute!" she thought. Her tummy felt a little bit grumbly. She had just eaten her yummy fish breakfast. She remembered what her Mummy always said. "Clean teeth help you feel good." Penny touched her small beak. Did her teeth feel clean? She was not so sure.
slides.speaker_notes: Penny is about to leave but pauses, recalling a reminder about clean teeth after breakfast.

slides.title: A Tiny Bit of Fish!
slides.text: Penny waddled to her small bathroom. She looked in the mirror. Oh dear! She saw tiny little bits. A small piece of fish was stuck! "Uh-oh!" she said softly. Penny remembered her special saying. "Healthy habits make every day fun!" Brushing her teeth was a very good habit. It made her feel sparkly and clean.
slides.speaker_notes: Penny finds a bit of food in her teeth and remembers her catchphrase about healthy habits.

slides.title: Brush, Brush, Brush!
slides.text: Penny grabbed her bright blue toothbrush. She squeezed a tiny bit of mint toothpaste. Swish-swish-swish! Up and down she brushed. She brushed her front teeth. She brushed her back teeth too. Penny sang a happy little song. Her webbed feet tapped on the floor. "Brush, brush, brush!" she sang. Her mouth felt very bubbly.
slides.speaker_notes: Penny cheerfully brushes her teeth, singing and tapping her feet, making her mouth feel bubbly.

slides.title: Ready for Fun!
slides.text: Soon, Penny rinsed her mouth. She spit out the bubbly foam. Her teeth felt so smooth. They looked shiny and white! Penny smiled a big, happy smile. "My teeth feel super clean!" she cheered. "Now I am ready to play!" Healthy habits made her feel healthy and strong. Penny was ready for a fantastic Saturday.
slides.speaker_notes: Penny finishes brushing, feels proud of her clean teeth, and is now ready for a wonderful day.
